nary_nodes.label: Ukraine strikes Russian refineries
evidence: Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit.
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks aimed at limiting oil revenues Moscow "uses to finance" its war.

nary_nodes.label: Russia attacks Ukraine
evidence: Meanwhile, Ukraine said at least 11 people were killed in Russian attacks, and the southern city of Kherson reported a total blackout.
Russia said it targeted fuel, energy and transport facilities.

nary_nodes.label: Drone attack on Yaroslavl
evidence: Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack".
Evraev said 93 drones were shot down over Yaroslavl region overnight.

nary_nodes.label: Drone attack on Balakliya
evidence: In Ukraine, three people were killed in the town of Balakliya, Kharkiv region, in an overnight Russian drone attack, the country's state emergencies service DSNS said.

nary_nodes.label: Drone attack on Lozova
evidence: Kharkiv regional head Oleh Synehubov later said that another two people were killed when drones attacked the train station in Lozova.

nary_nodes.label: Strikes on Dnipropetrovsk
evidence: Later on Thursday, five people were killed in Russian strikes on the central Dnipropetrovsk region, local officials said.

nary_nodes.label: Kherson blackout
evidence: In the south, the entire city of Kherson lost electricity after a "critical infrastructure facility" was hit overnight, regional head Oleksandr Prokudin said.

nary_nodes.label: Strike on Odesa ships
evidence: In Ukraine's Black Sea port of Odesa, one person was killed when Russia hit two dry cargo ships.

nary_nodes.label: Russia intercepts drones
evidence: Meanwhile, the Russian military said its forces intercepted or shot down 605 Ukrainian drones overnight over a number of regions.

nary_nodes.label: Russia strikes Ukrainian infrastructure
evidence: In its latest operational update, the military said it struck Ukraine's fuel, energy and transport facilities, as well as drone storage sites.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky: attacks limit oil revenues

nary_nodes.label: Evraev: largest drone attack

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky: patrol boats hit

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky: Russia must choose peace
evidence: "Russia must choose peace," Zelensky said, adding that Ukrainian attacks were "strengthening chances for diplomacy".

nary_nodes.label: NetBlocks: connectivity disruption

evidence: NetBlocks' head of research Isik Mater said connectivity did not fall to zero in part due to the use of "generators and backup supplies" in Kherson.
